verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is open-source (Apache-2.0) and documents support for open, vendor-neutral formats — glTF, OBJ, STL, and .babylon — plus exporters for Blender/Maya/3ds Max, meaning scenes and assets are not locked into a proprietary format and can be moved elsewhere freely. As a client-side rendering library rather than a SaaS with hosted user data, the 'leave' concept maps to asset/scene portability rather than account data export, which the docs cover well. Missing for 10: no explicit migration/export workflow docs framed as 'leaving the platform', and no independent hands-on verification of round-trip fidelity when exporting scenes to glTF/OBJ.
